Hlala uthule futhi uphefumule ngokujwayelekile uma ukuqopha sekuqalile ukuze uthole isifundo esinembe kakhulu.

Awekho ama-arrhythmia atholakele ngesikhathi sokuqopha. Isigqi sizinzile futhi siyahambisana nesigqi se-sinus esijwayelekile. Ukuzulazula kwesisekelo kuncane, futhi ikhwalithi yesignali ihlale iphezulu kuyo yonke iseshini.
Usizo luyaziswa ngendawo okuyo nezimpawu zakho zempilo.

Iseshini yakho yokugcina ye-ECG, eqoshwe ngo-09:15 AM, iphawule isigqi esingajwayelekile ukuze sibuyekezwe. Lokhu akusho ukuthi kunesimo esiphuthumayo, kodwa sincoma ukuthi uxoxe ngemiphumela nodokotela wakho ngokushesha okukhulu.
Idatha yakho ilondolozwa kule divayisi futhi izovumelaniswa ngokuzenzakalelayo uma usubuyele ku-inthanethi.
Khetha ulimi ongathanda ukulusebenzisa kuyo yonke i-app.
Isiqaphi sami se-PulseLink ECG sinikwa amandla kanjani?
Lesi sikhungo sosizo asisona esezimo eziphuthumayo zezokwelapha. Uma ubhekene nesimo esinjalo, sebenzisa inkinobho ye-SOS.

I-PulseLink isebenzisa inzwa ye-ECG yesiteshi esisodwa ye-AD8232 enamaphedi angu-3: RA/R (abomvu, ingalo yesokunene/isifuba), LA/L (aphuzi, ingalo yesokunxele/isifuba), kanye ne-RL/COM (aluhlaza, umlenze wesokunene/isisu esingezansi - i-electrode yereferensi). Ukuze uthole isignali ehlanzekile kakhulu, awabeke esifubeni: abomvu ngaphansi nje kwekholabhoni yesokunene, aphuzi ngaphansi nje kwekholabhoni yesokunxele, futhi aluhlaza emaceleni aphansi esokunxele noma esiswini esingezansi sesokunene, kude nezihlukazi ezinkulu. Qala ngokuhlanza nokomisa isikhumba, futhi uhlale uthule ngesikhathi sokuqopha ukuze unciphise umsindo.

Vula Ukuphathwa kwedivayisi kuideshibhodi bese uthinta u-\"Engeza idivayisi\". Vula isiqaphi sakho se-PulseLink AD8232, usigcine ngaphakathi kwamamitha angu-1-2, bese usikhetha uma sivela ohlwini lokuskena. Uma sesibhangqiwe, ibheji lesimo kuideshibhodi lizoshintshela ku-\"Kuxhunyiwe\".

Ifulegi le-\"isigqi esingajwayelekile\" lisho ukuthi isikhawu phakathi kokushaya kwenhliziyo okutholwe ngesikhathi seseshini yakho sibe ngaphandle kwebanga elilindelekile. Lena inkomba yokuhlola kuphela, akuyona ukuxilongwa - yabelana neseshini ephawuliwe nodokotela wakho nge-app ukuze abuyekeze ukuqoshwa.

Amaseshini aqoshwe ungekho ku-inthanethi afakwa emgqeni futhi avumelaniswa ngokuzenzakalelayo uma usunoxhumano oluzinzile lwe-Wi-Fi noma ludatha yeselula. Ungabheka amaseshini akulindile noma inini ku-Izilungiselelo > Isimo sokuvumelanisa, bese uthinta u-\"Zama ukuvumelanisa futhi\" uma iseshini isilinde isikhathi eside.

Isiqaphi se-ESP32-C3 AD8232 ECG sinikwa amandla ngokuqhubekayo ngekhebula le-5V USB Type-C elixhunywe ku-adaptha yamandla noma embobeni ye-USB. Alisebenzisi amabhethri angaphakathi, okuqinisekisa ukudluliswa kwe-telemetry okungaguquki ngaphandle kokwehla phezu kwenethiwekhi yasekhaya ye-Wi-Fi engu-2.4 GHz.

Qinisekisa ukuthi i-Bluetooth ne-Wi-Fi kuvuliwe efonini yakho, ukuthi isiqaphi sivuliwe (i-LED iyakhanya), nokuthi asixhunyiwe kakade kwenye ifoni. Sondela ngaphakathi kwamamitha angu-1-2 kusuka kudivayisi bese uzama futhi ngokuvula Ukuphathwa kwedivayisi. Uma isangaxhumi, qala kabusha isiqaphi ngokusikhipha emandleni imizuzwana eyi-10.

Ukuqoshwa kwakho kwe-ECG nedatha yephrofayela kudluliswa ngoxhumano olubethelwe futhi kugcinwa ngaphansi kwe-akhawunti yakho kuphela. Odokotela bangabona kuphela amaseshini obhangqwe nabo. Ungabuyekeza noma ucele ukususwa kwedatha yakho noma inini kusuka ku-Iphrofayela > Ubumfihlo.
Ayikho i-app ye-imeyili etholakele kule divayisi.

Isiqaphi se-ECG se-PulseLink sisebenzisa inzwa ye-AD8232, engaphambili yamaleyidi angu-3 (isiteshi esisodwa). Amaphedi ayo amathathu avame ukubizwa ngokuthi i-RA / LA / RL, noma nje i-R / L / COM kwezinye izindlu zesiqaphi. Landela izinyathelo ezingezansi ukuze uthole ukuqoshwa okuhlanzekile, okunomsindo omncane.

Hlanza izindawo zokubeka ngendwangu eyomile noma ngendwangu ye-alcohol. Gwema amafutha noma isikhumba esinamafutha - kwenza ingcina yephedi ibe buthaka futhi kwandise umsindo wesignali. Shefa indawo kuqala uma inezinweleni eziningi.

Namathisela iphedi ngalinye le-electrode elinenkinobho kuklampi yalo yeleyidi (R/obomvu, L/ophuzi, COM noma RL/oluhlaza) ngaphambi kokulinamathisela esikhumbeni - ukucindezela inkinobho ngemva kwalokho kuyakhungathekisa futhi kungenza iphedi ithambe.

Libeke emaceleni aphansi esokunxele noma esiswini esingezansi sesokunene, kude nomugqa wenhliziyo. Le i-electrode yereferensi/ye-ground futhi ayidingi ukuhlala eduze nezinye ezimbili.

Vula ukuhlola kwangaphambi kweseshini kuideshibhodi. Uma iphedi ikhululekile, i-app izophawula ukuthi \"Amaleyidi anqamukile\" - cindezela iphedi ngalinye ngokuqinile bese ubheka ukuthi isikrini sokuhlola sibuyekezwa sibe ngu-\"Kunamathiselwe\".

Ukubeka esifubeni kuveza isignali ye-QRS ehlanzekile futhi ende kunokubeka engalweni/emlenzeni futhi kunconywa ukuqapha okufana nasesibhedlela. Hlala uthule futhi uphefumule ngokujwayelekile ngesikhathi sokuqopha ukuze unciphise ukuphazamiseka kokunyakaza.
Lo mhlahlandlela wokusebenzisa isiqaphi sakho se-ECG se-PulseLink sokuzilibazisa futhi awuyena isikhundla sokubekwa kwama-electrode kwasemtholampilo noma seseluleko sezokwelapha.

I-PulseLink ixhuma iziguli nodokotela ngokuqapha i-ECG ukude: ithwebula idatha yesigqi senhliziyo kusuka kudivayisi ebhangqiwe, iyivumelanise ngokuphephile, futhi inikeze odokotela ukuqonda ngesikhathi esifanele mayelana nempilo yenhliziyo yeziguli zabo.
Lolu hlelo lwenzelwe ukuhlolwa kwezemfundo nokuhlolwa kwephrothothayiphu yasekliniki kuphela; aluyona idivayisi yokuxilonga yezokwelapha eqinisekisiwe.

Umuntu onesibopho: ithimba labafundi abathuthukisa i-PulseLink (uCameron van Heerden noMaxine Palm).

Ukuthobela: I-PulseLink icubungula ulwazi lomuntu siqu ngokuhambisana noMthetho Wokuvikelwa Kolwazi Lomuntu Siqu wama-4 ka-2013 (POPIA).

1. Ulwazi esilucubungulayo
Imininingwane ye-akhawunti (igama, i-imeyili, indima) nolwazi lwezempilo, kufaka phakathi ukuqoshwa kwe-ECG, izifundo zokushaya kwenhliziyo, amanothi eseshini nesimo sedivayisi. Ulwazi lwezempilo "lulwazi lomuntu siqu olukhethekile" ngaphansi kwe-POPIA futhi luphathwa ngokunakekela okwengeziwe.

2. Injongo nesisekelo somthetho
Idatha icutshungulwa kuphela ukuze kunikezwe ukuqapha i-ECG ukude, ukubuyekezwa kukadokotela nezexwayiso, kanye nokuhlolwa kwezemfundo. Ukucubungula kusekelwe emvumeni yakho futhi kukhawulelwe kulezi zinjongo.

3. Izivikelo zokuphepha
Idatha idluliswa ngokuxhumana okubethelwe futhi igcinwe ngezinsizakalo ze-Firebase. Ukufinyelela kukhawulelwe ngokuqinisekiswa nangendima (isiguli noma udokotela), kanye nokungena kwe-biometric okukhethwayo kudivayisi yakho.

4. Ukwabelana nokudluliselwa ngaphesheya kwemingcele
Idatha yesiguli ibonwa yisiguli nodokotela waso kuphela. Ayithengiswa futhi ayisetshenziselwa ukukhangisa. Ingqalasizinda ye-Firebase ingase icubungule idatha ngaphandle kweNingizimu Afrika; kudingeka ukuvikelwa okulinganayo ngokuhambisana nesigaba 72 se-POPIA.

5. Ukugcinwa
Idatha igcinwa kuphela ngenkathi i-akhawunti yakho isebenza noma njengoba kudingeka ekuhloleni, futhi iyasuswa uma uyicela lapho umthetho uvuma.

6. Amalungelo akho
Ungacela ukufinyelela, ukulungiswa, noma ukususwa kolwazi lwakho lomuntu siqu, uhoxise imvume, futhi uphikise ukucutshungulwa. Xhumana nethimba lokuthuthukisa nge-GitHub repository.

7. Izikhalazo
Ungafaka isikhalazo ku-Information Regulator (South Africa) ku-inforegulator.org.za.

1. Ukwamukela
Ngokusebenzisa i-PulseLink uyavuma le migomo.

2. Iphrothothayiphu yezemfundo
I-PulseLink iyiphrojekthi yomfundi eyakhelwe ukuhlolwa kwezemfundo nokuhlolwa kwephrothothayiphu yasekliniki. Akuyona idivayisi yezokwelapha eqinisekisiwe futhi akumele isetshenziselwe ukuxilonga, ukwelapha noma ukuqapha noma yisiphi isimo sezempilo.

3. Izimo eziphuthumayo
Esimweni esiphuthumayo sezokwelapha, xhumana nezinsizakalo zezimo eziphuthumayo zendawo yakho ngokushesha (eNingizimu Afrika: 112 noma 10177). Ungathembeli kule app ukuze uthole usizo oluphuthumayo.

4. Izibopho zakho
Nikeza ulwazi olunembile, ugcine imininingwane yakho iyimfihlo, futhi usebenzise i-app ngezinjongo ezisemthethweni kuphela. Odokotela basalokhu benesibopho esigcwele sokwahlulela kwabo kwezokwelapha.

5. Akukho siqinisekiso
I-app inikezwa "njengoba injalo" ngaphandle kwanoma yiziphi iziqinisekiso. Izifundo, izexwayiso nemibiko kungase kubambezeleke, kungapheleli noma kungabi nembile.

6. Umkhawulo wesibopho
Ngokwezinga elivunyelwe umthetho waseNingizimu Afrika, ababhali nesikhungo sabo abanasibopho nganoma yikuphi ukulahlekelwa noma umonakalo ovela ekusebenziseni i-app.

7. Impahla yengqondo
Igama le-PulseLink, uphawu nekhodi yomthombo kungumsebenzi wababhali futhi kwabiwa nge-GitHub repository yephrojekthi ngaphansi kwelayisensi eshiwoyo.

8. Izinguquko nomthetho obusayo
Le migomo ingabuyekezwa njengoba iphrojekthi ithuthuka. Ibuswa yimithetho yeRiphabhulikhi yaseNingizimu Afrika.
Alikho isiphequluli sewebhu esitholakalayo sokuvula le linki.
